title: The Last Train Home
excerpt: Two strangers miss the final train and spend one night walking across a city that never slows down.

sections.title: 11:58 PM
paragraphs: The train doors closed while both of them were still running.
Maya blamed the broken ticket machine. Theo blamed Maya for arguing with it.
Neither had enough money left for a taxi across the city.

sections.title: 2:16 AM
paragraphs: They found noodles beneath a fluorescent sign, watched a bakery begin its morning shift, and told each other things they had never told people who knew their surnames.
A city feels different when there is nowhere left to go.

sections.title: 5:41 AM
paragraphs: The first train arrived with the sunrise.
They stood on opposite platforms, each holding the other's phone number.
For once, neither of them missed the train.
